summary: FBRX 2.2.1 Beta (Weft): on Windows the title bar and menus follow FBRX's Light and Dark modes, and the built-in model's context window fits the graphics card.
notes: Windows: the title bar, menus and right-click menus follow FBRX's mode (Light, Dark or Match Windows) instead of always Windows' own, and change the moment you change it.
The File, Edit, View menu bar stays out of sight on Windows and Linux until you press Alt (FBRX has its own navigation; its shortcuts still work), and windows open in the color of your mode.

The built-in model's context window on Auto now fits the graphics card when the model runs there, so a long context no longer pushes part of the model off the card (slower); several graphics cards add up when judging what fits.
Downloading a model checks first that the disk has room for it, and says how much is needed.

server.summary: FBRX Server 1.3.1: a context window up to 128K tokens, bigger models made easy (gpt-oss 120B, Qwen3 235B and any GGUF model on Hugging Face), and new fbrx-server ai commands.
notes: The server's own AI keeps more in mind: on Auto its context window goes up to 128K tokens (as much as the memory, or the graphics cards, have room for). Administrators can set it in Mesh & AI → Models on this server, or with fbrx-server ai context.

New server models with long contexts: Qwen3 30B-A3B Instruct 2507 (the new pick for servers with 32 GB or more), gpt-oss 120B (quick on processors with 96 GB or more) and Qwen3 235B-A22B Instruct 2507 (192 GB or more).

Any GGUF model on Hugging Face by its name (owner/name, with a quantization after a colon): in the console's A model of your own, or sudo fbrx-server ai download owner/name --use. Big models in several files download as one, every file checked against Hugging Face's checksum.

fbrx-server ai recommend names the best model for this server; download --use downloads and switches in one go, with speed and time left; delete and context are new; a download checks the disk first (20 GB stays free).
From 1.1: sudo fbrx-server update check, then sudo fbrx-server update commit.

digger.summary: FBRX Digger 1.0: the FBRX Network Center on its own, every network tool included.
notes: Network scans and their comparison, ping and trace route, the speed test, the Wi-Fi channel planner, DNS and port checks, device consoles (SSH, Telnet) and network environments.
Runs next to FBRX OS without getting in its way: its own data folder, settings and no global shortcuts.
